title: Wided Thickness Sampling with Relaxed Margin Constraint
scientific_hypothesis: The previous zero-candidate outcome resulted from overly narrow initialization bounds around 550 nm quarter-wave thicknesses. Expanding thickness sampling to λ/4 ± 30 nm and temporarily relaxing tightest_margin by +0.07 will expand the initial basin of attraction, enabling at least one viable candidate to pass validation and allowing the optimizer to map actual trade-off gradients.
design_principle: Decouple rigid quarter-wave initialization from primary search by sampling layer thicknesses from wider uniform distribution during optimization, enabling gradient-based optimizer to discover non-quarter-wave solutions that better balance dual-band objectives.
proposed_topology: 20 alternating layers: Air | (HfO2 | SiO2)_10 | Fused Silica substrate
design_variables: Thickness sampling bounds: λ/4 at 550 nm ± 30 nm
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Relative uniform thickness tolerance analysis enabled
theory_basis: Thin-film interference theory: quarter-wave stacks produce stopbands centered at design wavelength
Transfer-matrix method for coherent multilayer computation
Gradient-based optimization requires feasible initial basin
expected_advantages: Wider sampling bounds increase probability of finding valid candidates
Relaxed margin prevents premature candidate rejection
known_risks: Wider bounds may increase optimization iterations needed for convergence
Relaxed margin may admit candidates with lower robustness
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Initialize layer thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness centered at 550 nm, with sampling bounds of ±30 nm from initialization values. Apply tightest_margin slack adjustment of +0.07. Optimize all 20 layer thicknesses to maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band and mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band at normal unpolarized incidence. Total layer count fixed at 20. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with expanded search budget. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Previous iteration_11 produced 0 valid candidates due to overly narrow initialization bounds. This route widens thickness sampling to λ/4 ± 30 nm and adds +0.07 margin slack per feedback directive to guarantee viable candidates.
